0x000A96.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000AC5.en: 「Tch!! What a short show that was!」

0x000B7D.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000C46.en: 「Kh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000C81.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000CD5.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000E26.en: 「So this is it...... The rest is up to you.」

0x000E58.en: 「Dammit...!@　So this is where it ends!」

0x000E94.en: 「Ngh! You got the drop on me......」

0x000F1F.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000F5D.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x00104F.en: 「Ngh...... So I'm the one to fall...... Ejecting!」

0x0010CE.en: 「Th-this is as far as I can go...!」

0x001106.en: 「Ow ow ow... You got me. Miscalculation on my end.」

0x001147.en: 「Well, shoot, they went and got me!」

0x00118B.en: 「Nn... gh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x0011F8.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00123F.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001274.en: 「Damn it! Is this all I've got...!」

0x001360.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@ I still have so far to go...!」

0x0013AE.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001469.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001498.en: 「Ah, no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0014D6.en: 「Well well, so this is the end.」

0x001505.en: 「I can't go on any further. If you'll excuse me.」

0x001590.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0016F6.en: 「Ejecting now...@ Ngh...! Can't even do this gracefully...」

0x0017B4.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001923.en: 「So I still have far to go too...!」

0x001984.en: 「A-all hands!@ Abandon ship is top priority...!!」

0x0019C6.en: 「No good, I've gone and gotten myself hit.」

0x001A7A.en: 「No response! The Garden of Balal and the barrier are both gone!」

0x001B99.en: 「Heh... heh heh... Now that the god of Balal has perished...@ it seems I am to share the same fate...」

0x001C26.en: 「......It is well...... This is as it should be...@ Deceived by them, under Balal...」

0x001C97.en: 「For one who committed so many sins as I... this is only just...」

0x001CF0.en: 「......Only... to be at the side of your father and mother...」

0x001D2A.en: 「......You fought alongside us and saved this world.@ That deed is no sin. Therefore......」

0x001DA1.en: 「Heh heh... With such words... you would see me off...」

0x001E50.en: 「......So she was freed from the god's curse......」

0x001EA0.en: 「......With this, it is finished.@ I'll leave the rest to those gathered here.」

0x001F11.en: 「Where will you go...? No, what do you intend to do now?」

0x001F57.en: 「Depending on your answer, do you mean to cross swords with me?」

0x001F9D.en: 「......Yeah. You've got a track record, after all.」

0x001FDD.en: 「You may rest easy.@ I have already escaped@ Volkruss's control.」

0x002061.en: 「What...!? Just how did you manage that!?」

0x00209E.en: 「There is no need for me to tell you that.」

0x0020D5.en: 「......And you expect me to believe that?」

0x002109.en: 「Yang Long,@ what Lord Shu says is the truth.@ I was there myself.」

0x0021EA.en: 「I was there too.@ I'll vouch that Lord Shu isn't lying.」

0x00227A.en: 「Hey, what's with that?! Why the sudden change in attitude?!」

0x0022B7.en: 「......Go, Shu. Get out of here already.@ But if you try anything funny,@ I won't let you off easy.」

0x002384.en: 「Lady Monica, will you continue on with Shu from now on...」

0x002436.en: 「See you again§@ ...is how it goes, I suppose?」

0x0024B9.en: 「I guess so.@ Whatever that guy did back in La Gias...@ up here on the surface, he never worked against us.」

0x002558.en: 「Yeah... that's true.@ If anything, he helped us out.」

0x0025B4.en: 「Besides, we just went through a fight like that...@ Honestly, I'm beat...」

0x00263C.en: 「XO, order all units to return to the ship.」

0x002694.en: 「......You've truly done well.@ Thanks to all of you, the Earth sphere was saved.」

0x0026F6.en: 「Also, the Grand Christmas probe is turning up evidence that Alteur plotted former President Graien's assassination.」

0x0027A1.en: 「It shouldn't be long@ before your names are cleared.」

0x002822.en: 「Yes, the discharge order will likely be rescinded.」

0x002868.en: 「But even if I was framed,@ I'm still guilty of causing the former President's death...」

0x0028DC.en: 「We'll do what we can about that matter too.@ We won't treat the heroes of this war unfairly.」

0x00295C.en: 「By the way...@ is Mekibos Volkuede there?」

0x0029B5.en: 「Yeah, I had business with your side too. The Zovorc Privy Council rejected a treaty with Earth for a stance of non-interference.」

0x002A75.en: 「You started this fight yourselves...@ and now you claim to know nothing of it?」

0x002ADD.en: 「In the first place,@ didn't the Privy Council view Earthlings as a threat?」

0x002B39.en: 「That we did...@ but through these battles, that way of thinking has changed.」

0x002BA7.en: 「Still... if we tried to sign a peace treaty now,@ it'd only cause more friction. Your own leadership@ is in an uproar as it is.」

0x002C4C.en: 「You mean a cooling-off period is needed?」

0x002C7D.en: 「That's about the size of it.@ And our forces have already pulled out, by the way.」

0x002D01.en: 「I contacted Roff and the others earlier and ordered them home.@ By now they've warped out and left the Earth sphere for good.」

0x002D8D.en: 「Sorry to report it after the fact,@ but we wanted to avoid pointless trouble on our end.」

0x002DFE.en: 「And so... you're the one who stayed behind.」

0x002E35.en: 「Yeah... this time as a direct pipeline,@ with no Nibhal in between.」

0x002ED7.en: 「That's right. I'll count on gentlemanly treatment, yeah?」

0x002F39.en: 「Vice Admiral... after this, where are we@ to head next?」

0x002F9B.en: 「Go to Mizudori Island in Japan and stand by there.@ You'll receive further orders in due course.」

0x003024.en: 「However, I'll leave how to treat the non-military personnel@ to their own judgment, and to yours.」

0x0030DD.en: 「Time sure flies......@ A month since that battle with the Gan Eden......@ To think I'd live to pass through Kaminarimon again.」

0x003176.en: 「Michiru, what are you talking about?@ It's only been about a week.」

0x0031DE.en: 「More to the point, why is this guy here...」

0x003209.en: 「Well, we don't have much choice.@ As someone connected to that incident, he's got to@ stay with us for a while.」

0x00329F.en: 「Just slap a guard or whatever on a guy like this@ and ship him back to Osaka already.」

0x003310.en: 「We can't do that...@ Even Shouko and the others are stuck at home on special leave.@ Normally they'd still be on Mizutori Island...」

0x0033C1.en: 「All right, all right, I get it.」

0x0033E6.en: 「Well, I was born in Tokyo, so@　I'm pretty at home over here too.」

0x00347F.en: 「Yeah. Moved to Osaka when I was ten.」

0x0034E1.en: 「Best of all, I get to be with Shouko.@　Nothing makes me happier.」

0x003534.en: 「You bastard... try anything funny with Shouko and@　I'll cut you down with the Over Kaiser Sword!」

0x0035C3.en: 「I'll knock it right back with the G Bankaran!」

0x00360C.en: 「You want the G Compati Kaiser and the G Bankaran@ to fight each other? Forget it!」

0x00367D.en: 「Both of you -- if you don't get along,@ I won't cook dinner for either of you!」

0x003723.en: 「Tch, this guy...@　And here you were going on about conquering the whole country!」

0x00378B.en: 「Oh, about that.@　Kouta, how about you and me shake down every high school in Japan?」

0x00380F.en: 「You and me, we could pull it off.@　What d'you say? Be my right-hand man and...」

0x003877.en: 「Hmph. Who'd be your right-hand man?@　Besides, you've got the wrong targets.」

0x0038FE.en: 「The ones I'll take down@　are the ones after Asakusa... after this whole planet.」

0x003957.en: 「When those guys show up,@　I'll fight them as Fighter Roar...@　in the G Compati Kaiser.」

0x0039FB.en: 「...If we've got the OK by special dispensation,@　then we're heading back to La Gias.@　We got through to old lady Ybun too.」

0x003A97.en: 「I see... It'll feel lonely without you.」

0x003ABF.en: 「If anything comes up, call us on the Ether comm.@　We'll come running.」

0x003B2D.en: 「But you've got things you have to@　take care of over there, don't you?」

0x003BB1.en: 「We have our duty to fulfill@　as Masou Kishin pilots.」

0x003C10.en: 「I'd have liked to relax on the surface a while longer...@　but I'm worried about things back home too.」

0x003C81.en: 「Give it your all back in La Gias, everyone.」

0x003CBE.en: 「And you in another way too, Zashford.」

0x003D42.en: 「Um... please give my regards to Gennacy.」
